metaTitle: Custom Etched Household Items | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom etched household items in bulk. Perfect for corporate gifts and promotional use. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Etching creates a permanent, elegant mark on glass, metal, and wood household items. Unlike printed logos that may wear off, etched designs remain crisp through years of daily use. For corporate gifts like drinkware, serving trays, or decorative pieces, etching adds a sophisticated touch that recipients appreciate. Choose from clear frosted finishes on glass or deep impressions on stainless steel for a premium look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom etched household items including glassware and stainless steel drinkware with permanent frosted logos
